events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Denver cornerback Bradley Roby returned Jamaal Charles' second fumble 21 yards for a touchdown with 27 seconds remaining, completing a stunning comeback in the Broncos' 31-24 victory over the Kan
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos' late TD off Charles fumble stuns Chiefs

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 466 yards -- the second-most of his career -- and three touchdowns in leading the New England Patriots to a 40-32 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws for 466 yards, leads Patriots past Bills 40-32

headlines.description: Carson Palmer threw for four touchdowns to lead the Arizona Cardinals to a 48-23 victory over the Chicago Bears, who lost Jay Cutler to a hamstring injury Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer throws 4 TDs in Cardinals' 48-23 win over Bears

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw three touchdown passes, and the Cincinnati Bengals quickly ended Philip Rivers' streak of perfect passing while pulling away for a 24-19 victory over the San Diego Chargers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton throws for 3 TDs; Bengals beat Chargers 24-19

headlines.description: Johnny Manziel threw a 60-yard touchdown pass to Travis Benjamin on Cleveland's second play and connected with his wide receiver again for a clutch 50-yarder with 2:52 left, giving the Browns a 2
headlines.shortLinkText: Manziel's 2 TD passes lift Browns over Mariota, Titans 28-14

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson had 192 total yards and the Minnesota Vikings rebounded from a rough season opener for a 26-16 victory Sunday over the Detroit Lions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson, Vikings keep Lions winless with 26-16 victory

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Jameis Winston passed for a touchdown and ran for another, and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers held on to defeat the mistake-prone New Orleans Saints 26-19 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston wins for first time as Bucs QB, 26-19 over Saints

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New York Giants

headlines.description: Julio Jones caught a perfect 37-yard pass from Matt Ryan, setting up Devonta Freeman's 2-yard touchdown run with 1:14 remaining, lifting the Atlanta Falcons past the New York Giants 24-20 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Julio Jones unstoppable in Falcons' 24-20 win over Giants

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger passed for 369 yards and three touchdowns, DeAngelo Williams tied a team record with three rushing scores and the Pittsburgh Steelers overwhelmed the San Francisco 49ers 43-18
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers go for 2 and everything else, crush 49ers

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Rookie Matt Jones ran for 123 yards and two touchdowns, an efficient Kirk Cousins avoided turnovers, and the Washington Redskins dominated for a half, then held on to beat the St. Louis Rams 24-1
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie RB Jones, revamped D lead Redskins past Rams

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw two touchdown passes and somersaulted into the end zone for another score to lead the Carolina Panthers to a 24-17 victory over the Houston Texans on Sunday.
Derek Carr threw a 12-yard touchdown pass to Seth Roberts with 26 seconds left to cap the most productive day of his young career and lead the Oakland Raiders to a 37-33 victory over the Baltimor
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr's late TD pass rallies Raiders past Ravens

headlines.description: Rookie Jason Myers kicked a 28-yard field goal with 40 seconds remaining and the Jacksonville Jaguars held on to beat the Miami Dolphins 23-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Myers' chip shot helps Jaguars beat Dolphins 23-20

headlines.description: Tony Romo joined Dez Bryant on the injured list with a broken left collarbone, but the Dallas Cowboys shut down DeMarco Murray and beat the Philadelphia Eagles 20-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo injured, but Cowboys beat Eagles

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for two touchdowns and the Green Bay Packers outlasted the Seattle Seahawks for a 27-17 win Sunday night in a rematch of last season's NFC title game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steady Rodgers throws 2 TDs as Pack downs Seahawks

events.name: New York Jets at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw two touchdown passes and the Jets' defense forced five turnovers Monday night to give New York a 20-7 victory at Indianapolis.
headlines.shortLinkText: Defense propels Jets as 5 turnovers cost Colts
